It's so easy to find edge in the market:

• Go on YouTube.
• Watch some videos on trading strategies.
• Pick the simplest strategy.
• Write down its rules on a piece of paper.
• Forward-test the strategy for 30 trades to get used to it.
• Back-test it for 200 trades.
• If it's not profitable, go look for another strategy.
• Repeat this process until you find something that actually works.
• Start trading it live.

It's that simple, my dudes.

用 Claude 搭的 @Polymarket  bot，第一晚跑完，利润 $2,314。

脚本花了 4 个小时写出来。

平均 胜率 大概 70%。

这不是那种夸张的 clickbait，更像是一个很典型的案例：当你把 Claude 接进真实交易流程里，它不只是聊天工具，而是可以帮你把策略变成能跑的系统。

Wallet：
https://t.co/u2PQ4M13iM
这套策略的核心很简单：

5 Minute BTC / ETH Micro Arbitrage。

它专门做 Polymarket 上 5 分钟的 BTC 和 ETH 短周期合约。在行情快速波动的时候，YES + NO 的总价格有时会短暂低于 $1。这个时候市场出现临时 mispricing，bot 会实时扫描，一旦发现 spread，就立刻吃掉。

重点不是预测 BTC 接下来 5 分钟一定涨还是跌。

重点是捕捉价格暂时错位的那一瞬间。

人类交易员在波动来的时候，会犹豫、会确认、会怕追高、会怕买错。但 bot 不会。它只看规则：价差出现，满足条件，直接执行。

很多机会窗口可能只有几秒。

等大多数人反应过来，价格已经修正了。

这也是为什么这类策略更适合自动化。它不是追求一笔暴赚，而是不断重复吃小 spread。单次利润可能不大，但只要频率足够高，执行足够稳定，小 edge 就会慢慢堆成可观收益。

Claude 的价值也在这里。

不是让它告诉你“买 Up 还是 Down”，而是用它帮你写脚本、整理逻辑、处理异常、优化执行，把一个想法变成能 24/7 跑的交易系统。

剩下的事情就是继续 refine code，扩大部署规模，然后让系统自己跑。

如果你不想自己从零写 bot，也可以先用这个入口观察类似策略和高胜率钱包的实时操作：
https://t.co/zZRd9pX4Dg

真正的问题不是这套策略能不能跑一晚。

而是你有没有能力把一个有效的小 edge，变成可以持续执行的 workflow。

你觉得 Polymarket 5分钟市场，未来会被这类微套利 bot 吃干净吗？

This trading strategy changed my life

I do not care about catching the entire move
I do not care about being on the right side of the day
I do not care about catching 500 pt trades

I just take my entry model when it presents itself.
That is it. It is that simple.

For example, this morning we saw $ES $SPY break below the opening range with an aggressive sweep. 

When I see a sweep of the opening range low, while smart money is buying for higher.. I assume it is a fakeout

So instead of waiting for the manipulation to happen, I become APART of the manipulation

I use a tool on @flowtopia_co called "WAVE" to track smart money. Calls did not hold up all day but when we swept the range the first time, they were extremely bullish.

Target was the opening range high & we basically had a PERFECT exit on the day... WAVE sold off shortly after & that was the new high of day.

It does not have to be complicated
It does not have to be difficult

It is STUPID SIMPLE if you do not overthink it.
